prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city, where several national delivery apps already operated. Diners who ordered through the firm's app paid the firm, never the kitchen, and the firm kept a fifth of each bill before sending on the rest, on the same terms the national apps used. Owners never learned who their customers were, the app showed every kitchen in the same plain format, and complaints reached owners only as forwarded messages. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: Every order and payment passed through the firm, which kept a cut, so owners saw it as their trade's "middleman." "Pioneer" fails because it used the same terms the national apps already used. "Publicist" fails because it showed every kitchen the same way, promoting none, and "referee" fails because it only forwarded complaints rather than deciding them.

pioneer.quote: same terms the national apps used
pioneer.why: it copied an existing arrangement, so it was not first

publicist.quote: every kitchen in the same plain format
publicist.why: treating every kitchen alike promotes none of them

referee.why: passing complaints on is not settling them

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city, where several national delivery apps already operated. Its software let each restaurant take orders on its own website, which none of the national apps then allowed. Within three years every one of those apps had built a near copy, while restaurants using the firm's version went on paying only a flat yearly license, keeping every diner's payment themselves, and settling their own complaints. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: The firm offered something no app had allowed and was later copied by all of them, so owners saw it as their trade's "pioneer." "Middleman" fails because restaurants kept every diner's payment themselves. "Publicist" fails because restaurants paid only a license for software, not for promotion, and "referee" fails because restaurants settled their own complaints.

middleman.why: no money passed through the firm

publicist.why: paying for a tool is not paying for promotion

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city, where several national delivery apps already operated. Restaurants paid the firm to appear in its weekly short videos, a format the national apps already used in larger cities, and a featured kitchen often had a line outside the next morning. Those diners phoned or walked in and paid the restaurant directly, so the firm never learned whether any meal had gone well or badly. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: Restaurants paid the firm to put them before the public, and crowds followed, so owners saw it as their trade's "publicist." "Pioneer" fails because the national apps already used the format. "Middleman" fails because diners paid the restaurant directly, and "referee" fails because the firm never even learned how meals went, so it could settle nothing.

referee.quote: never learned whether any meal had gone well
referee.why: a firm unaware of disputes cannot decide them

worlds.passage: In 2015 a small software firm began working with independent restaurants in one mid-sized city, where several national delivery apps already operated. Its website hosted diners' reviews, as the national apps' sites did, and when a restaurant disputed a review or a diner disputed a bill, both sides sent their evidence to the firm and abided by its decision. Owners said they trusted those decisions because the firm took no money from restaurants and none from diners' meals. By 2018, most of the city's restaurant owners spoke of the firm as their trade's ______.
worlds.explanation: Both sides brought disputes to the firm and accepted its decisions, trusting its neutrality, so owners saw it as their trade's "referee." "Pioneer" fails because the national apps' sites already hosted reviews. "Middleman" fails because it took no money from diners' meals, and "publicist" fails because it took no money from restaurants.

pioneer.quote: as the national apps' sites did

publicist.why: no restaurant paid to be promoted
